title: Synthetic Symbiosis
description: Engineering bacterial-fungal consortia for division of labor in lignocellulose bioconversion and metabolic exchange.

title: Myco-Materials
description: Programming fungal hyphae to express variable chitin content, creating functional living composites for construction and sensing.

title: Metabolic Sovereignty

title: Planetary Remediation
